title: The rings, faded
logline: The dock planks ten days after the sequence's rings: the rings almost gone, rain and boots, the bird's prints in the grain if you look. The page looks.

panels.composition: Close on wet dock planks with two pale rings almost weathered away and tiny bird prints in the wood's grain, rain.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, close on wet wooden dock planks with two pale rings almost weathered away and tiny bird prints in the grain, rain, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
